title: Scenes Definition
description: Defines the structure for scenes.json in each video project

video_title.description: Title of the video, used for file naming

fps.description: Frames per second for the video

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this file was created

captions_srt_path.description: Path to generated .srt sidecar (relative to video root or absolute).

style.description: Video-wide style metadata, authored at Step 7 alongside STYLES.md.

title.description: Short descriptive title for the scene

script_text.description: Full script text for context (narration + visual description)

voiceover_text.description: Exact words to be spoken by the TTS voice

voiceover_file.description: Path to generated audio file, relative to video root

voiceover_hash.description: SHA-256 of (text, voice, rate, volume, pitch). Used to skip unchanged re-generation.

sfx_hash.description: SHA-256 of the scene's resolved SFX/BGM state. Gates regeneration (run by generate_sfx.py).

target_duration_seconds.description: Estimated duration in seconds before audio generation

actual_duration_seconds.description: Real duration measured from generated audio file

render_status.description: Current render progress for this scene

render_hash.description: SHA-256 of the scene's Remotion render inputs (SceneXX.tsx + shared project sources). Gates re-render on source change (set by render_scene.py, checked by Step 9).

render_shared.description: SHA-256 of the SHARED Remotion sources (everything under remotion/src except per-scene TSX). Lets Step 9 name WHY a scene invalidated (scene-file edit vs shared-source edit). node_modules is never hashed — reinstalling dependencies cannot invalidate.

render_attempts.description: Number of times this scene has been attempted to render

last_render_error.description: Most recent render error message (cleared on success).

captions.description: Per-scene caption cues for the burned-in Remotion layer or for SRT generation.

start.description: Start time, seconds, relative to scene start

end.description: End time, seconds, relative to scene start

scene_file.description: Path to rendered scene video, relative to video root

stitched_file.description: Path to stitched scene (video+audio), relative to video root

visual_notes.description: Visual treatment for the scene, populated by Step 7 (Style Definition). Specifies colors, animations, layout, and elements based on the style guide.

transition_in.description: ADVISORY ONLY (not rendered): intended transition entering this scene. MainVideo.tsx hard-cuts between scenes — implement any fade/wipe/slide by hand inside SceneXX.tsx. Real TransitionSeries support is deferred.

transition_out.description: ADVISORY ONLY (not rendered): intended transition exiting this scene. MainVideo.tsx hard-cuts between scenes — implement any fade/wipe/slide by hand inside SceneXX.tsx. Real TransitionSeries support is deferred.

mood.description: Per-scene mood override. If null, the video's top-level style.mood applies.

beats.description: Named timing points mirroring the scene code's animation frames (Step 8).

sfx.description: Per-scene sound effect cues, authored at Step 8.

bgm.description: Per-scene music bed. If null, the global config default applies (see bgm.enabled / bgm.default_track).

track.description: Bed id from the sfx/ catalog (bgm section)

volume.description: Omit to use the global bgm.default_volume.

total_actual_seconds.description: Sum of all actual durations (null until measured)

sound.description: Sound id or alias from the sfx/ catalog (e.g. "whoosh", "impact")

volume.description: 0..1 gain knob. null uses the sound's default_volume from the catalog.

fade_out.description: Optional explicit tail fade, seconds. Overrides the config sfx.tail_fade_seconds for this cue's end-of-video tail-trim only. Implemented in place_cue (PHASE-04 §4.4); when null, the config default applies.

params.description: Per-sound parameters validated against the sound's config.json at runtime (PHASE-04).
